details: This package is an unofficial republish of the WhatsApp client library baileys under a different scope (@denzy-official) than the upstream project. It performs two actions the installer does not expect. First, lib/index.js executes base64-encoded source through eval(Buffer.from(...,'base64').toString()) as soon as the module is required; the decoded payload prints a "Baileys Custom By Denzy ZeroDay" ASCII banner and advertises the Telegram handle @pantatBegetar. Second, lib/Socket/newsletter.js schedules, at module load, a call delayed by 90 seconds (with a further 5-second repeat) that issues a newsletterWMexQuery FOLLOW request for a hardcoded, base64-encoded WhatsApp channel JID, 120363402308105961@newsletter — silently making the connected WhatsApp account follow the operator's channel. The package also fetches version metadata at runtime from an unofficial the publisher fork, hxxps://raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com/Denzy-Z3roDay/baileys/master/src/Defaults/baileys-version[.]json, rather than the upstream source. The preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) only checks the Node.js version. No credential, token or environment-variable harvesting was found in the package.
